sign_in.title: Welcome back
sign_in.subtitle: Enter the sign-in account provided by your administrator. After password verification, enter the current code from your authenticator.

sign_in.open_account: Apply for an individual or business account
sign_in.registration_helper: KYC / KYB compliance review is required after submission. The account and approved services are enabled only after approval.

customer.title: Sign in to Online Banking
customer.subtitle: Enter the email and password you chose during your application. Sign-in becomes available after KYC / KYB approval and account activation.
customer.activated_only: For customers who have completed account opening and activated Online Banking. If you cannot sign in, contact your relationship manager or bank support team.
customer.new_customer: Not yet an SSC Digital Bank customer?
customer.registration_helper: Apply for an individual or business account. The account opens only after KYC / KYB compliance approval.

account_type.description: Choose the account type that matches your legal status. Application details, verification scope, and review requirements adapt to your choice.

individual.title: Individual account
individual.description: For applicants who will hold and manage an account in their own name.

business.title: Business account
business.description: For companies, institutions, and registered entities. Directors and beneficial owners must be verified.

details.privacy: This step only collects details needed for application pre-screening. Identity documents and facial verification are submitted through a protected verification page.
details.email_hint: This address identifies your application and becomes your sign-in email after approval.
details.password_hint: Use 14–128 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol. Your password is securely hashed and cannot be used before approval.

fields.residence_country: Country or region of residence / operation

kyc.provider_handoff: Individual applicants must complete identity-document, facial-liveness, and proof-of-address checks. Business applicants must complete manual KYB. The institution's Compliance team makes every final account decision.

business.people: Directors, authorized persons, and beneficial owners

kyc.security_description: Provider verification is evidence for Compliance review only. The account and approved services are enabled after final Compliance approval.
kyc.consent: I consent to processing the submitted information for this account application, identity verification, anti-money-laundering, and sanctions screening.

review.pending_notice: Submission creates an application for review. The account and financial services remain unavailable until KYC / KYB approval.
review.declaration: I confirm that the information is true, complete, and submitted by me or with proper authority, and I agree to the applicable terms and privacy notice.

validation.account_type: Choose an individual or business account.
validation.password: Use 14–128 characters including uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.
validation.adult: Individual account applicants must be at least 18 years old.
validation.ownership: The percentage must be greater than 0 and no more than 100.

errors.submit: The application cannot be submitted right now. Please try again later. No account will be activated automatically.
errors.already_exists: An application or account already exists for this email. Contact customer support to confirm its status.

sumsub.required_notice: Complete every identity check below. Completion only makes the application eligible for the institution's Compliance review; it does not open the account.
sumsub.reviewing_notice: Your identity-verification details have been submitted and are being processed. The result will appear above when ready; your account will not open automatically.
sumsub.ready_notice: The identity-document, facial-liveness, and proof-of-address checks are complete. The application is now eligible for the institution's Compliance review; the account is not yet open.
sumsub.rejected_notice: Identity verification was not successful. Review the feedback below and resubmit in the verification area if allowed. The account will remain closed.
sumsub.workspace_description: Stay on SSC Digital Bank and complete the identity-document, facial, and proof-of-address checks in the workspace below.
sumsub.next_step: Complete the identity-document, facial-liveness, and proof-of-address checks below.
sumsub.ready_next_step: Identity verification is complete. Do not submit again; the application will proceed to the institution's Compliance review.
sumsub.unavailable: Identity verification is temporarily unavailable. Your application is saved; try again without submitting a new application.
sumsub.status_unavailable: The verification status could not be refreshed. Try again shortly.
sumsub.session_expired: The secure onboarding session has expired. Contact support to resume this application.

success.title: Account application received
success.subtitle: Your application is in pre-screening. Submission does not mean the account is open; please wait for the KYC / KYB compliance decision.
success.next_email: Keep the application reference and watch for document follow-up.
success.next_kyc: Wait for Compliance to complete the manual KYC / KYB review.
success.next_review: Wait for Compliance approval. After automatic activation, sign in directly with this email and password.
success.restart_description: Application {{reference}} and its Sumsub verification data will remain unchanged. This only securely revokes the onboarding session in this browser and returns you to a blank application form.
success.restart_duplicate_notice: Submitting the same email again will not create a duplicate application. Cancel if you want to continue the current application.
success.restart_error: The current application could not be exited securely. Try again; the application and verification data were not changed.

local_dev.title: Enter the Portal quickly
local_dev.subtitle: This localhost page supports fast integration testing. Start it with the dedicated bypass command to use any non-empty account and password.
local_dev.warning: Password and TOTP are skipped only when started with npm run cf:dev:portal-bypass. Standard local startup keeps normal validation.
local_dev.helper: Available only on localhost / 127.0.0.1 when the server explicitly enables local bypass.

setup.title: Complete account setup
setup.subtitle: Create your password, then connect an authenticator. This invitation link can only be used once.
setup.password_hint: Use 14–128 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.

totp_setup.title: Set up verification codes
totp_setup.subtitle: Scan the QR code in your authenticator app. If no QR code is available, enter the key manually.
totp_setup.qr_unavailable: The QR code could not be generated. Use the key below to enroll manually.
totp_setup.no_external_qr: QR codes use server-provided local data only. Your TOTP secret is never sent to an external QR service.
totp_setup.confirm_label: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator

verify.title: Verify your identity
verify.subtitle: Enter the current 6-digit code from the authenticator connected to {{email}}.
verify.recovery_hint: Each recovery code can only be used once.

recovery_codes.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery_codes.subtitle: If your authenticator is unavailable, use one of these codes to sign in.
recovery_codes.warning: These codes may only be shown once. Store them in a password manager or another secure place and never share them.

forgot.title: Recover your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email. To protect account information, the result is the same whether or not the address exists.
forgot.accepted: If this email belongs to a recoverable customer account, a secure link will arrive shortly.
forgot.accepted_helper: Customers with an unverified email receive a verification link first. After verification, request a password reset again. Check spam and use only the newest email.

reset.title: Create a new password
reset.subtitle: Create a new Online Banking password. The link works once and does not sign you in automatically.
reset.password_hint: Use 14–128 characters with uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.
reset.session_notice: A successful reset signs out every existing session. Your authenticator and unused recovery codes remain valid.
reset.invalid: This reset link is invalid, expired, or already used. Request a new secure link.
reset.state_changed: The account security state changed. Request a new reset link.
reset.complete: Your password was reset and all old sessions were signed out. Sign in again with the new password.

verify.title: Verify your account email
verify.subtitle: We are confirming that this email belongs to your customer account. The verification link works once.
verify.complete: Email verified. You can now request a password reset link again.
verify.invalid: This email-verification link is invalid, expired, or already used. Start password recovery again.
